result:
Scheduled publishing is implemented. `bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` passes (21 tests, 19 of them new); `bun run lint` is clean too. Nothing is committed.

## Decisions to review

- **The home page also hides scheduled posts.** Its "Latest posts" list would have leaked them. It shows public posts only, even to the author.
- **Edit, update and delete answer 404 for someone else's scheduled post.** They would otherwise answer 403, which confirms the post exists. Public posts still answer 403 to non-authors, as before.
- **`bin/console.ts` now sends boot-time log output to stderr.** The framework prints its "Applied migration" notice to stdout during boot, which would have put an extra line in the report whenever a migration was pending. This affects every console command, not just the new one.
- **An empty string for `publishAt` means "publish now"**, same as absent or `null`.
- **A time without a zone is rejected** (e.g. `2026-10-01T09:00`), since the server would otherwise read it in its own time zone. The form converts the author's local time to UTC before sending.
- **Tabs and line breaks in a title are printed as spaces in the report**, so each post stays on one line.
- **The author sees their own scheduled posts in search**, consistent with the posts list.

## Known limitation

The list and search compare `published_at` as text. That is exact for the UTC format the app writes. A value written by hand in another shape (no milliseconds, a non-UTC offset) can be off by up to the offset, but only close to the publish moment.

## Test database

My first test run hung on a bug in my own test helper and I had to kill it, which skipped its cleanup. I deleted the five rows it left in `data/guren.test.db`, and later four sample rows I inserted to check the report. The test database is back to its seeded state. Running the console command also applied the new migration to the dev database `data/guren.db`.

## Summary

I added a nullable `published_at` text column to `posts` (`db/schema.ts` plus a generated migration under `db/migrations/20260929193029_add_published_at_to_posts/`) and put the visibility rule in `app/Models/Post.ts`, which `PostController`, `HomeController`, `PostPolicy` and `PostResource` all use; the resource now carries `publishedAt` and a `scheduled` flag. `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` accepts the optional `publishAt` field, and the controller stores it normalised to UTC. The report is the new `app/Console/Commands/PostsScheduledCommand.ts`, registered in `src/console.ts`, with `bin/console.ts` changed to keep boot output off stdout. On the front end, a shared `resources/js/components/PublishAtField.tsx` is used by the create and edit pages, and the list and post pages show the go-live date to the author; the `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated with `bun run codegen`. Tests are in `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts`, and the design is recorded in `docs/adr/0002-scheduled-posts-are-hidden-at-read-time.md`, left as `draft` for someone to verify.
